brief:
Drop Site News reported that teachers in Gaza are establishing makeshift educational facilities with minimal resources and funding to serve children displaced by the destruction of the formal school system. Over recent months, these improvised classrooms have become the primary venue for instruction across the territory.

Educators operating these informal schools face severe constraints, relying on volunteer efforts and whatever materials they can gather rather than sustained governmental or international support. Few facilities have access to basic supplies or secure physical spaces. The ad hoc arrangements emerged as the only available option for children whose schools were damaged or destroyed during the conflict.
dek: With few resources and little funding, makeshift educational facilities established over the past several months are working to provide some schooling to children in Gaza.
title: Gaza teachers improvise schools amid system collapse
